_comment: M7-15 counted-series retune: evolve the police brain UNDER THE PAIR-LOCKED PHYSICS (multiplicative_book_v1) against a POOL of the four measured worlds - the claim-reading evader (his cheapest counter), his announced fix, the reference heuristic, and a random walker (the M7-14 single-opponent retune overfit to the claim-reader and stalled against randomness; the pool is the structural fix). Fitness = mean capture rate across the pool, seeds 401..416, disjoint from the DoD seeds (1..32), the reference-GA seeds (201..216) and the arena measurement (1..32).
